title: Pair a device with a one-time code
description: Section 6. The host (or its relay) showed the code K7QM-3XRD. The client redeems it once and gets a device id and token for every later connection.

steps.note: Open a connection for pairing. Through a relay this is wss://<relay>/oal/pair/<code>; on the LAN it is the host's own /oal.
host/pair instead of host/hello: the code, and the device's name and X25519 public key (kept for end-to-end encryption in 0.2).
The device's id and secret token, and the host's info, including its public key. The connection is now authenticated as this device.
Heartbeat: a client sends host/ping when it has sent nothing for 20 seconds.
The paired devices. `current` marks this one.
